title: evidence
description: One claim about one source location, with its verification status. A claim without a source_path and location is not evidence.

manifest_id.description: Links back to the repo_manifest that produced this file. Provenance is preserved end to end.

source_path.description: File path relative to the manifest's source_root.

location.description: Symbol or line range. At least one is required in practice.

evidence_type.description: Implemented/partial/stubbed/simulated describe the source. Tested/verified require an executed check.

verification_status.description: A printed PASS is not confirmation. Only an executed check moves this off 'unverified'.

limitations.description: What this evidence does NOT establish.
